title: A NEW COMPOUND OF δ-MnO2 FAMILY; δ-MnO2(II)
abstract: Abstract                Black precipitate of so-called δ-MnO2 was found usually to be a mixture of two different kind of compounds (δ-MnO2(I) and δ-MnO2(II)). Crystallographic conversion took place between these compounds in the presence of their mother liquid.
